description: This file defines the LocalNotificationManager class responsible for creating and displaying local notifications within an Android app, specifically tailored for notifications related to calendar or astrology events.

classes.name: LocalNotificationManager
classes.description: Manages the creation and display of local notifications, including setting up notification channels and constructing notifications for success or failure events.

methods.name: createNotificationChannel
methods.description: Creates a notification channel for Android Oreo and above with specified ID, name, and description.

methods.name: showEventNotification
methods.description: Constructs and displays a notification with a given title, message, and ID, opening MainActivity when clicked.

methods.name: showBackupSuccessNotification
methods.description: Displays a notification indicating backup was successful.

methods.name: showBackupFailureNotification
methods.description: Displays a notification indicating backup failed.
